LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.label: dory
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.description: A two-and-a-half metre ash spear with a leaf-shaped iron head. If the head breaks, the hoplite turns it round and fights with the bronze spike.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Xiphos.label: xiphos
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Xiphos.description: A short double-edged sword with a leaf-shaped blade, carried as a sidearm when the spear is lost.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Xiphos.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Xiphos.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Xiphos.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Kopis.label: kopis
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Kopis.description: A heavy single-edged blade that curves forward, so that every blow lands like an axe.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Kopis.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Kopis.tools.1.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Toxon.label: toxon
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Toxon.description: A short recurve bow of horn and sinew. It draws fast and shoots hard for its size.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Toxon.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Gastraphetes.label: gastraphetes
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Gastraphetes.description: The 'belly bow': a heavy bow on a long stock, spanned by leaning the belly on a curved rest. It shoots harder and further than any hand bow.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Gastraphetes.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Musket.label: Hellenic musket
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Musket.description: A flintlock musket with silver bands and a meander inlaid along the stock, carried by the volunteers who first marched under the blue and white. A socket bayonet makes it a spear when the powder runs out.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Musket.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Musket.tools.1.label: bayonet
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rifle.label: Hellenic rifle
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rifle.description: A single-shot bolt rifle with silver bands and a long sword bayonet. The evzones carried it into the mountains.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rifle.tools.1.label: bayonet
